changes.comment: ai-assist: thinking-off fixes from the first live model-tier run. New IAiProviderDescriptor.anthropicThinkingOffTypes, AnthropicThinkingOffType, IAnthropicThinkingOffRule and AiAssist.resolveAnthropicThinkingOffType declare a per-model Anthropic thinking-off value beside the 'disabled' default. claude-sonnet-5-5 (@anthropic:sonnet, the base tier) declares 'between_tools' and leaves thinkingRequiredModelPrefixes, so a generic effort 'none' there now sends thinking {type:'between_tools'} instead of being degraded to 'low' (or refused under onUnsupported 'fail'), on the completion, streaming and client-tool paths; executeClientToolTurn sends a caller-built anthropicThinkingDisabled flag the same way instead of refusing it. Behaviour change for alias users: the base tier's 'none' is now real thinking-off — the model does not think before it responds — but the short updates it writes between tool calls still come back as thinking blocks; a generic 'none' sends no effort beside it (an explicit 'other' block or caller-built otherParams can; between_tools 400s at xhigh and max). Gemini: gemini-3.5-flash-lite (rejects thinkingBudget 0 with 400 INVALID_ARGUMENT) joins thinkingRequiredModelPrefixes, so 'none' on @google-gemini:flash-lite is sent as 'low' (budget 1024), or refused under onUnsupported 'fail'. The entry is dash-bounded, so it also matches future variants of the id. This is interim until ai-assist sends Gemini's thinkingLevel.
